visual_text: Has she felt dizzy or fainted since starting donepezil?
These tablets can slow the pulse. Let me check it now.
Tell the GP about any dizziness or fainting. A faint can look like a fall.
Illustrative dialogue, not a real patient
Visits per 1000 people a year, older people with dementia
About 81,000 older people with dementia, Ontario, Canada, 2002 to 2004
Shows a link, not that the tablet caused every faint
Gill et al., Arch Intern Med 2009
alt_text: Illustrative comic in three panels at a pharmacy. A pharmacist asks an older woman and her son whether she has felt dizzy or fainted since starting donepezil, checks her pulse at the wrist, and tells them to report dizziness or fainting because a faint can look like a fall.

Bars: hospital visits for fainting per 1000 people a year, about 32 for older people with dementia taking these tablets and about 19 for those not taking them. Ontario, Canada, 2002 to 2004. Shows a link, not that the tablet caused every faint.
